published_hash_basis: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF converted to LF; original BOM presence preserved.

clip_evidence.hash_basis: Unmodified original file bytes; all source_line columns are one-based in the JSONL journal.

join.trigger: matched craft2 ACCIDENT_TRIGGER; matching craft4 STORAGE_CONFIRMED required
join.time_note: This capture's mock producer added 5000 ms to ITS time; the captured job IDs use its inverse. This is a legacy capture mapping, not a general epoch rule or new calibration.
join.cross_check: canonical_event_id local timestamp (UTC+09:00) must equal the derived Unix nanoseconds
join.journal: Exact full job_id across craft4 uploader.service CAMERA_READY_ACCEPTED (video_bytes), UPLOAD_START (metadata_bytes), and SPOOL_COMMIT_COMPLETE (bytes, already_present=0). Video plus metadata must equal spool bytes for every clip.

clip_evidence.byte_meaning: clip_sizes.bytes is MP4-only video_bytes from CAMERA_READY_ACCEPTED (source_line). metadata_bytes and spool_bytes retain the separate metadata and combined sizes with their own source lines. No MP4 files are copied.

formulas.cpu_two_stage_core_seconds: (N - N1) * fov_cost + (N1 - N2) * negative_cost + N2 * positive_cost
formulas.road_and_total_reductions: ratio of summed costs, not the unweighted mean of scenario percentages

scope: Historical 2026-09-28 hardware costs use the pre-event 10-second video implementation and 15-second device-wide averages, not the later pre-8/post-2 implementation.
The same observed unit costs are applied to synthetic random road scenes. Geometry maps cost branches; it is not an AI accuracy assumption or a new performance measurement.

Network estimates count MP4 payload bytes only, excluding the separately recorded metadata, protocol overhead, retransmissions and other device traffic. Equal mean clip size is assumed for every modeled upload.
CPU is idle-subtracted device-wide core-seconds, including branch processing and encoding/upload where present. It is not isolated model inference time.
The CPU comparator runs AI for all neighbors, mapping independent geometry visibility to positive or negative measured branch costs. No CPU claim is made for the all-upload network comparator.
The accident vehicle's own video and CPU are a common term outside all reported witness totals; no own-video size is assumed.
Retained and missed independently visible vehicle counts are reported alongside the estimated cost reductions.
